cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James disclosed that independent contractor financial advisors receive a higher payout percentage on the revenues they generate than employee financial advisors, because independent contractors are generally responsible for all of their own direct costs.
items.quote: Our financial advisors who are independent contractors are generally responsible for all of their direct costs and, accordingly, receive a higher payout percentage on the revenues they generate than employee financial advisors.

items.text: Raymond James disclosed that employee advisors have tiered payout systems, so that as production increases an advisor moves higher up the payout grid.
items.quote: even on the employee side, we have tiered payout systems. And so as production increases, you kind of get higher up on the payout grid as well.

items.text: Compensation for employee financial advisors primarily includes a payout on the revenues they generate, and these advisors also participate in the firm's employee benefit plans.
items.quote: Compensation for these financial advisors primarily includes a payout on revenues they generate and such advisors also participate in the firm's employee benefit plans.

items.text: Raymond James disclosed a payout of up to 50% for the Traditional Employee affiliation model, along with employee benefits.
items.quote: Payout + Benefits: Up to 50% payout** and full array of competitive employee benefits offerings.

items.text: Raymond James disclosed a 70-80% gross payout for the Advisor Select affiliation model, along with employee benefits.
items.quote: Payout + Benefits: 70-80% gross payout** and full array of competitive employee benefits offerings.

items.text: Raymond James disclosed an 81% to 90% payout for the Independent Contractor affiliation model.
items.quote: Payout + Benefits: 81% to 90% payout***. Leverage our third party partnerships to create a benefits package that best fits your team.

items.text: Raymond James disclosed an 81% to 90% payout for the Corporate RIA affiliation model.
items.quote: Payout + Benefits: 81% to 90% payout***. Leverage our third-party partnerships to create a benefits package that best fits your team.

items.text: Depending on a financial advisor's annual revenue generation with the firm, the advisor can receive a higher portion of the Fee paid to the firm (so the firm retains less of the Fee), and advisors may share portions of their payout with other advisors.
items.quote: depending on your financial advisor's annual revenue generation with the Firm, your financial advisor can receive a higher portion of the Fee paid to the Firm (therefore, the Firm retains less of the Fee paid).

items.text: Newly affiliated RJA financial advisors through the Advisor Mastery Program may receive a salary in addition to advisory fees (or commissions and trails for brokerage accounts) for a period of time, and that salary declines each year as the advisor's number of clients and revenues increase.
items.quote: Newly affiliated RJA financial advisors through our Advisor Mastery Program may receive a salary in addition to advisory fees (or salary in addition to commissions and trails in the case of transactions in brokerage accounts) for a period of time.

items.text: Raymond James disclosed that its competitive pay packages include base salary, incentive bonus, and equity compensation programs, along with retirement and benefit plans and non-qualified deferred compensation plans for certain associates.
items.quote: Our competitive pay packages include base salary, incentive bonus, and equity compensation programs.

items.text: Registered representatives of RJA are employees of the firm and earn commissions for recommending transaction-related services in a brokerage account, and may receive commissions and/or trail fees.
items.quote: In his or her capacity as a registered representative, your financial advisor earns commissions for recommending transaction-related services to you in a brokerage account.

items.text: Raymond James disclosed that advisors receive financial incentives for affiliating, including transition assistance, bonuses, deferred compensation arrangements, enhanced pay-outs, repayable business transition or working capital loans, and administrative fee reimbursements.
items.quote: These arrangements include, but are not limited to, transition assistance, bonuses, deferred compensation arrangements, enhanced pay-outs, repayable business transition or working capital loans, and administrative fee reimbursements.

items.text: Qualifying financial advisors are awarded membership in recognition clubs based on production, client assets, and other criteria, which can result in benefits such as paid travel, reimbursement of business expenses, and deferred compensation awards.
items.quote: Qualification for recognition clubs can result in benefits to the financial advisor such as paid travel, reimbursement of certain business-related expenses, and deferred compensation awards.

items.text: Raymond James maintains various deferred compensation plans (including the Voluntary Deferred Compensation Plan and Long-Term Incentive Plan) for the benefit of certain employees and independent contractors.
items.quote: We maintain various deferred compensation plans for the benefit of certain employees and independent contractors that provide a return to the participant based upon the performance of various referenced investments.
